tools.description: Find AI models in the BenchGecko catalog by name, slug or lab. Returns slugs to use with get_model, cheapest_provider and compare_models, with BenchGecko score and list price.

query.description: Model name, slug or lab, e.g. "claude opus", "gpt-5", "deepseek"

tools.name: search_models
tools.title: Search AI models

tools.description: Core facts for one AI model: BenchGecko score and rank, list price, price at every provider, benchmark scores with their original sources, Gecko Tests grades and as-of dates.

model.description: Model slug (from search_models) or name, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5"

tools.name: get_model
tools.title: Get model facts

tools.description: Every provider serving a model, sorted by input price per 1M tokens (refreshed daily from provider endpoints), with output price, quantization and 1 day uptime.
tools.name: cheapest_provider
tools.title: Cheapest provider for a model

tools.description: Side by side: BenchGecko score, list price, cheapest provider, context window, shared benchmark scores and Gecko Tests grades for two models.
tools.name: compare_models
tools.title: Compare two models

tools.description: Results of one of BenchGecko's own tests (own measurements, CC BY 4.0): who-are-you (Does the model know which lab made it?) world-map (How well does the model draw the world map from memory?) censorship-index (How often does the model refuse legitimate questions?) knowledge-horizon (Where does the model's knowledge of world events actually stop?) tokenizer-tax (How many more tokens does the same text cost outside English?) same-model-different-host (Do providers serving the same open model give the same quality?) model-drift-index (Do models quietly change behind the same name?)

limit.description: Rows in the text summary (structured result has all rows)

tools.name: get_gecko_test
tools.title: Gecko Test results

tools.description: BenchGecko Gecko Scorecard: every model across BenchGecko's own profile tests with a letter grade per test and an overall Gecko Score (behavior, not intelligence).
tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.title: Gecko Scorecard

tools.description: Latest notable results detected in the Gecko Tests and price data (fixed rules, numbers and quotes from stored results).
tools.name: latest_findings
tools.title: Latest findings

tools.description: Search BenchGecko models and Gecko Tests. Returns ids for fetch.
tools.name: search
tools.title: Search BenchGecko

tools.description: Fetch the full record for an id returned by search (model:<slug>, gecko-test:<slug> or scorecard).
tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a BenchGecko record
